svg.title: Capsule shape code — FLAME
svg.desc: Direction C (a shape code instead of a letter): a solid wedge (FLAME) cut in ink out of the hot-magenta face. Four marks that differ in TOPOLOGY — vertical spray, horizontal bar, ring, solid triangle — because at 13 screen px a letterform differs from another letterform only in stroke detail, and stroke detail is the first thing minification eats.
